description:
modules/devicescan/http/checkin — POST /api/iot/checkin (#5004): one
kiosk scan inside its request transaction (BEGIN to COMMIT), with the
device session's heartbeat; device authentication runs before it and
shows as Server-Timing "auth". The route-sized test router has no
request settings cache, so each settings read counts. Flat from three
to eight children present.
ADR 0124: +2 statements for SAVEPOINT and RELEASE around the heartbeat.
ADR 0136: -1 statement net (child lock +1, gate inside the row lock -1,
EndVisit without its read -1). Source and destination room metadata are loaded together through Facilities.ListRoomsByID; capacity admission still rereads under its room lock. Activity-limit admission now runs under the session row lock; the existing-child and session-occupancy checks share one tenant-scoped query, saving one statement without changing request settings memoization.
